scope.holdout: Never open holdout/; only development geometry keys from public exports, raw input points and training images/depth.
prohibited: WIDEN outcome arrays, classifications, components, result metrics

prior_order: LoD2 only where ALS patch support is absent

gt_support.rule: Per owning face tangent plane, assign raw nadir GT to closest patch within half-cell in both tangents. Select outermost >=20% layer. Use points within selected layer +/-0.15 m. Count / actual patch area. Exclude multiple qualifying layer runs as ambiguous correspondence.
gt_support.alignment: frozen stage1 v3 common_shift; no new fitting

mvs.source: full-area training geometric depth; finite positive values are COLMAP geometric-consistency survivors
mvs.correspondence: Project a real selected-layer GT point nearest its patch median, require same-pixel GT z-buffer visibility (0.25 m tolerance); sample exact 1024x741 geometric depth pixel; signed error = (unprojected MVS - GT) dot patch normal.
mvs.median: median of absolute per-view normal residuals; per-component median of patch medians
mvs.pass_share: passed geometric depth samples / visible projected GT samples
mvs.visibility: local input tile including 10 m context; no neighbour pixel filling

components.area: sum of distinct input patch areas
components.cross_tile: join by stable building and spatial overlap

task0.colour_scatter: per GT point median RGB Euclidean deviation from its across-visible-training-view median RGB; component median; RGB in [0,1]
task0.material: top ten by area, original-resolution best and most-oblique visible training crops, independent agent choice glass/metal/other/unknown
task0.selection: keep only glass/metal; building total eligible component area descending, choose largest component; within 10% choose larger MVS error; stable IDs break exact ties
task0.if_empty: Report no qualifying material; do not substitute B173 or relax thresholds

selection.c_change: REGIONFIG-v1 example a unchanged; virtual view perpendicular to long axis at 35 degrees if no oblique training view >30 deg
selection.c_repr: B0 LoD2 evaluation roof faces: median signed vertical prior-GT +0.10..+0.30 m AND median abs MVS-GT <0.05 m, largest patch count. If absent, negative range; no result reads.
selection.a_roof: flat roof normal tilt <=10 deg in B0/B173 neighbourhood/R1 evaluation range; nadir training tilt <=20 deg; largest missing-depth fraction, then face ID then image stem
selection.a_wall: R1 wall 19, DJI_20241217101317_0011_D, PHOTOFIG-v1 exact patch column
selection.a_specular: task0 selected component and c_specular photo unchanged
selection.d: old stage1 B0 LoD2 seed0; evaluation ROI >50% image; largest geometric-mask pass share; no result-based selection
selection.e: task0; REGIONFIG a correction; c_repr; VISCMP-v4 V2 face53
selection.b: REGIONFIG-v1 exact a/b sections, photo crops and 0.25m input bins; DIST71 TSDF and point-distance files; no vertical clipping

execution.gpu: figure d rendering only, skip if occupied

novice_check: Each figure independently to context-free agent; one sentence, one layout-only revision allowed; keep both replies verbatim
